protocol.name: xd_window_rectangles_v1

description.summary: XeonDesktop: where the windows are on the screen

protocol.description: For the Snipping Tool's Window Snip and Alt+Print Screen: the outer rectangle (frame included) of every window on the screen, front to back, in the desktop's logical coordinates. Offered to every program that may capture the screen (no sandboxed one): a program that can capture the screen can see the windows anyway.

request.name: get_rectangles

description.summary: the windows as they are now

request.description: Sends the rectangles of the windows on the screen now (not minimized), then done. The list isn't updated afterwards.

entry.name: activated
entry.summary: the window with the keyboard focus
